profile.name: Full name

trading.description: How new orders start out and what the terminal shows. These pre-fill and guard the order ticket — every order is still checked by the trading engine.
trading.amountModeHint: What the amount field in the order ticket measures.
trading.amountHint: Pre-filled in an empty ticket. Leave blank for none.
trading.tifHint: Limit and stop orders stay active until filled or cancelled — the only mode the engine supports.
trading.confirmOrdersHint: Buy and Sell need a second press within 4 seconds.
trading.stopLossHint: Distance from the entry price. Turns TP/SL on in the ticket; the exact price is set when you press Buy or Sell.
trading.takeProfitHint: Distance from the entry price, applied the same way.
trading.riskPerTradeHint: Warns in the ticket when the loss at your stop would exceed this share of equity. It doesn't block the order.
trading.marginModeHint: Each position has its own margin and liquidation price. Cross margin isn't available.
trading.riskNote: Blank means off. Percentages are of the entry price (stop loss, take profit) or of your equity (risk per trade).
trading.showFeesHint: Estimated fee in the order ticket.
trading.showLiqHint: Estimated liquidation price in the ticket. Hiding it doesn't change when liquidation happens.
trading.showAvailHint: Always shown when funds are insufficient.
trading.pnlHint: How open positions show unrealised P&L.
trading.confirmCloseHint: Close needs a second press within 4 seconds.
trading.invalidLeverage: Leverage must be a whole number from 1 to 125
trading.invalidAmount: Default amount must be greater than zero
trading.invalidPct: Percentages must be greater than 0 and at most 100

charts.description: How the terminal's chart opens and what it draws.
charts.volumeHint: Bars along the bottom, where the market supplies volume.
charts.crosshairHint: Magnet snaps the horizontal line to the candle's close.
charts.autoScaleHint: Price axis always fits the visible candles. Off lets you stretch the axis and pan vertically.
charts.positionsHint: Entry, TP/SL lines and open/close markers.
charts.ordersHint: Unfilled limit and stop orders at their prices.
charts.rememberHint: Keep your last timeframe, chart type and indicators on this device. Drawings are always saved.
charts.resetHint: Restores the defaults on this page and forgets the remembered layout. Drawings are kept.
